title: Interop day: committer authority on role changes (bans, adds) on both hubs
description: When Haven keeps the ratchet tree and checks who made a role change (Jason 238470: today only the target role is checked). Extend mimid-chat /roles with variants that give the member role no canBan, and no canAddParticipant; then on Haven's hub (or our copy at the new commit): a ban by a member without canBan, an add by a member without canAddParticipant, and a change not in the actor's authorized_role_changes must be refused; the same Commits refused by mimid's hub (hub/policy.rs authorize_commit). Today's ban test: mimid-1wgh.46.19, tools/interop/chat /ban.
notes:
2026-11-16 prep: mimid-chat 682585b adds /roles no-ban and /roles no-add. Baseline on local mimid (main): ban without canBan refused notAllowed; with canBan accepted; invite without canAddParticipant refused already at keyMaterial (mimid answers noConsent: hub/key_material.rs:131, no policy code in protocol-07 §5.2), so the Commit-level add check is not reached through mimid-chat. For Haven: their hub may not check keyMaterial authority; then the Commit-level check is what to test. Script: /host or /create; /roles no-ban; /invite <b>; /ban <b> (expect refused); /roles no-add; /invite <c> (expect refused); /roles ban; /ban <b> (expect accepted).
Correction: the baseline ran mimid built at 00:54 from the rewritten main (before 6dbe357 nonces), not the current tip; the authorization code it exercises (hub/policy.rs, key_material.rs, update.rs) last changed in 10e30b5, before that build, so the result holds.
Haven upstream now tracks a room's ratchet tree once a full GroupInfo+tree seeds it (ffd9e24, ff914c6; Zulip 240186) and checks committer authority on role changes (room-policy §8.1), roles from GroupContext per room-policy PR #52. Re-test on the interop day; could run locally against their hub before.
2026-11-17 run, local only (loopback, run.sh namespace), Haven mimi-hubd fdce222 and mimid (branch haven-recheck 58d2734: mimid-chat gains /tree full|ds, /roles ban-no-change, /fetch, From on the JSON lane; mimi-mls Member::pending_ratchet_tree 55a863d).
Seeding Haven's tracking: mimid-chat by default (and mimid-agent always) sends RatchetTreeOption distributionService, which never seeds (.46.20.7). With /tree full the bundle carries the next epoch's full tree beside the Full GroupInfo; hub log 'r/auth1 is tracked from epoch 3, seeded by b.example'. Order matters: a tracked room refuses a first roles_list by Commit (PR #52 reading), so /roles goes before /tree full.
Haven script (alice@b.example, carol and erin on haven.localhost with mimid KeyPackages via the JSON lane, alice added on the operator listener): /adopt auth1; /invite carol; /roles no-ban; /tree full; /policy discoverable=false (seeds); then
 T1 /ban carol (no canBan, 2->1 listed): REFUSED, 200 UpdateRoomResponse notAllowed, errorDescription 'the proposer's role does not authorize the change'
 T2 /roles ban-no-change (accepted: role has canChangeRoleDefinitions); /ban carol (canBan, 2->1 not listed): REFUSED, notAllowed, same description
 T3 /roles no-add (accepted); /invite erin: keyMaterial success (local route checks consent only, .46.6.16), Commit REFUSED notAllowed, same description
 allowed: /roles ban; /invite erin -> success; /ban carol -> success (1 client removed); /who: list alice, carol (role 1), erin; leaves alice, erin; epoch 8.
 Control, same script without /tree full (untracked): every Commit accepted, T1-T3 included, room_tree empty (DIV-15 says so).
mimid hub (local mimid, a.example, JMAP mode, users alice/carol/erin): /host auth1; /invite carol; /roles no-ban;
 T1 /ban carol: REFUSED notAllowed, errorDescription empty (by design, bead mimid-1wgh.49); debug log 'membership action ChangeUserRole { from_role_index: 2, target_role_index: 1 } is not authorized ... role 2 does not hold capability 0x000f' (the reason names canChangeUserRole only; canBan is also accepted per decision mimid-1wgh.3.26)
 T2 /roles ban-no-change; /ban carol: REFUSED notAllowed; log '... no authorized_role_changes entry allows role 2 to 1'
 T3 /fetch erin (role may add); /roles no-add; /invite erin with the fetched KeyPackage: Commit REFUSED notAllowed; log 'AddParticipant { target_role_index: 2 } is not authorized ... role 2 does not hold capability 0x0000'. /invite erin again: keyMaterial noConsent (hub/key_material.rs: 'keyMaterial refused by room policy ... role 2 does not hold capability 0x0000')
 allowed: /roles ban; /invite erin -> success; /ban carol -> success; epoch 8.
Both hubs agree on every outcome. Differences: Haven explains each refusal in errorDescription (one text for all three); mimid leaves it empty and logs the reason at debug; Haven checks adds at keyMaterial only for another provider's user, mimid for every user. Logs: session scratchpad auth/haven-run1.log, auth/haven-run-untracked.log, mimid2/alice.log, mimid2/server.log.
